format.use: Instagram Reel for the luxury barbershop TIM DESIGN

global_style.realism: Photorealistic live-action footage, as if shot on an ARRI Alexa 35 with anamorphic 35mm and 100mm macro lenses: true-to-life materials (leather grain and stitching, brushed metal with micro-scratches, veined marble, real glass, real plant leaves), physically accurate light and reflections, natural film grain. Absolutely no cartoon, illustration, 3D render or CGI look.
global_style.palette: Colors strictly matte black #111111, brushed gold #C9A24B and warm cream #F3EEE3; the only other color allowed is the natural green of the plants and of the football pitch on the TV.
global_style.lighting_and_grade: Moody low-key lighting, deep blacks, warm 2700K golden highlights from brass pendant lamps, slightly desaturated warm cinematic grade, subject razor sharp, soft creamy bokeh.
global_style.set: An upscale modern barbershop called TIM DESIGN, completely empty of people: matte black walls, cream veined marble floor, dark walnut counters, brass pendant lamps, two black leather barber chairs with gold details, round gold-framed mirrors, lush green plants (monstera, olive tree, hanging pothos) in matte black pots, a dark walnut reception desk with the brushed-gold TIM DESIGN logo backlit on the black wall behind it, and a waiting lounge with a black leather sofa, two armchairs, a low marble coffee table and a wall-mounted flat TV playing a live football match.
global_style.tv: The TV shows a live football match from the wide broadcast camera: bright green pitch, players tiny and distant, no readable score, no team or channel logos.

shots.label_fr: Façade de nuit puis entrée dans le salon
shots.subject: Exterior at night: the TIM DESIGN storefront, matte black façade, a backlit brushed-gold 'TIM DESIGN' sign above a tall glass door, warm golden light from the salon spilling onto wet pavement with soft reflections, plants visible through the window. The camera then glides through the glass door into the salon, where the gold TIM DESIGN logo glowing on the reception wall comes into focus
shots.camera: slow steady push-in on a gimbal, continuous single move from outside to inside
shots.motion: light reflections sliding on the glass and the wet pavement
shots.transition_out: hard cut on the beat drop

shots.subject: Extreme macro of a matte black pomade jar with a brushed-gold lid finely engraved 'TIM DESIGN', on dark walnut
shots.camera: fast rack focus from a blurred foreground to the engraved lid
shots.motion: a sharp glint of golden light crossing the lid

shots.subject: Extreme macro of polished gold barber scissors opening on black leather
shots.motion: blades opening, light flashing along the edge

shots.subject: Extreme macro of a gold straight razor opening on a folded cream towel
shots.motion: blade catching a flash of golden light

shots.subject: Vintage barber pole with black and gold spiral stripes and a glowing cream-white globe on a matte black wall
shots.camera: low angle close-up, quick upward tilt

shots.subject: Wide establishing shot of the whole empty salon: the two black leather barber chairs, round gold-framed mirrors, brass pendant lamps, green plants, and the reception desk with the glowing gold logo in the background
shots.camera: slow smooth dolly-in at chest height
shots.motion: dust particles drifting in the warm light beams
shots.transition_out: fast zoom-in transition (wide to close) with motion blur

shots.subject: Top-down view of a dark walnut barber station: straight razor, black combs, gold scissors, shaving brush and a folded cream towel, perfectly aligned with equal spacing
shots.motion: warm light reflections moving across the metal
shots.transition_out: fast pull-back transition (close to wide) with motion blur

shots.label_fr: Salle d'attente, plantes et match à la télé
shots.subject: Wide view of the waiting lounge: black leather sofa and two armchairs, low marble coffee table with a few TIM DESIGN products on it, monstera and olive tree in black pots, and the wall-mounted flat TV playing a live football match, its green pitch glowing in the dark room. The TV shows a live football match from the wide broadcast camera: bright green pitch, players tiny and distant, no readable score, no team or channel logos.
shots.motion: the TV image moving, leaves catching the warm light

shots.subject: Floating dark walnut shelves lined with matte black and amber glass bottles and jars with gold caps, every label printed 'TIM DESIGN' in brushed-gold capitals, perfectly aligned, visible glass texture and clean reflections
shots.camera: macro slider moving slowly along the shelf, very shallow depth of field
shots.motion: a thin line of warm light sweeping across the gold labels
shots.transition_out: fast zoom-in transition onto one bottle

shots.subject: Macro of a single matte black TIM DESIGN bottle with a gold cap standing on a black marble plinth, the gold 'TIM DESIGN' lettering razor sharp and centered
shots.motion: gold rim light tracing the edges of the bottle

shots.subject: Wide view of the reception area: dark walnut desk, the brushed-gold TIM DESIGN logo backlit on the black wall behind it, tall green plants on both sides, the salon softly lit in the background

shots.label_fr: Téléphone devant le salon avec Instagram
shots.subject: A matte black smartphone rises upright by itself from the reception counter into the foreground, nobody holding it; the whole salon stays visible and softly blurred behind it. Its screen lights up with the TIM DESIGN Instagram profile: round gold logo avatar, the name 'TIM DESIGN', a grid of nine black-and-gold photos of the salon and products, and a gold 'S'abonner' button
shots.camera: low angle, slow push-in toward the screen
shots.motion: phone sliding up smoothly, screen lighting up

shots.label_fr: Le téléphone s'efface, retour au salon
shots.subject: The same smartphone in the foreground, screen on, in front of the salon; the focus pulls from the phone to the salon behind it, then the phone slides down out of frame and the salon is sharp again
shots.camera: rack focus from foreground to background, then very slow push-in
shots.motion: phone gliding down out of frame

shots.subject: Close-up of a black leather barber chair headrest and polished gold armrest, leather grain and stitching clearly visible
shots.motion: warm reflections gliding on the leather

shots.subject: A round gold-framed mirror reflecting the whole empty salon, the plants and the warm pendant lamps, no person in the reflection
Macro of a professional gold hair clipper resting on black leather
shots.camera: slow lateral slide along the blade
shots.motion: sharp highlights running across the gold teeth

shots.subject: Calm, simple shot of the reception wall with the backlit brushed-gold TIM DESIGN logo, plants framing both sides, the area below the logo left dark and empty
shots.motion: a single soft gold light sweep across the logo, lights dimming slightly

on_screen_text.anim: fade in + scale 95%->100% over 0.5s, dissolve out at 3.0s

on_screen_text.style: [POLICE CANVA], gold #C9A24B, 96px, wide letter spacing, centered above the phone
on_screen_text.anim: letters reveal left to right over 0.4s with a gold shimmer, ding sound
fade in 0.6s, fade out with the final fade

negative_prompt: people in the salon, customers, barbers, hands, fingers, arms, faces, body parts, silhouettes, people reflected in mirrors (the only people allowed are tiny distant football players on the TV screen), cartoon, illustration, anime, 3D render, CGI look, video game look, plastic textures, misspelled or garbled letters, any text other than TIM DESIGN, other brand names or logos, TV channel logos, watermark, subtitles, colors outside black/gold/cream except plant green and pitch green, blue or purple tint, neon lights, daylight, harsh flat lighting, blown-out highlights, blurry or out-of-focus subject, warped or melting objects, deformed tools, extra blades, duplicated objects, clutter, hair on the floor, dirt, flicker, jitter, shaky handheld camera, fisheye distortion, dutch angle, low resolution, noise, compression artifacts
